title: Chroma Quantization Parameter Extension
subject: Video coding apparatus that sets chroma quantization parameters relative to luma QP using picture-level chroma QP offset and quantizes orthogonal-transformed picture data.
description: Encoding apparatus for video using chroma QP derivation and quantization of transform data.

claims.preview: Encoding apparatus configured to set chroma QP from luma QP plus picture-level offset and quantize transform data.
claims.exact_text: An encoding apparatus, comprising : circuitry configured to : set a chroma quantization parameter (Q P ) included in a chroma QP range from 0 to 51 equal to a luma QP value, based on a parameter including a picture level chroma QP offset added to a luma QP ; and quantize transform data that is orthogonal - transformed from a picture , based on the set chroma QP to generate quantized data .

notes: Prepared assessment input. Additional claims are not yet in this adapter; All claims means all claims exposed here.
